en.title: PrepMate, the 15 in 1 chopper that ends slow kitchen prep
en.description: A 15 in 1 vegetable chopper with dice, slice, julienne and grate blades, a catch container, egg separator and a safety hand guard. Prep a full meal in minutes and clean up in seconds.

en.b2d: Everything drops into the built in container, so no mess on the counter and no bowl juggling.

pt.title: PrepMate, o cortador 15 em 1 que acaba com o preparo lento
